name: flash-attention-cuda
title: Build Flash Attention in CUDA from Scratch
primer:
This is a CUDA project: each step is a Python file holding ONE CUDA source string,
named exactly for the step (e.g. the `vector_add` variable holds the CUDA for the
vector_add step). You edit the CUDA inside that string. At grade time the source
is JIT-compiled with nvcc (CUDA 12.3, g++-12 host compiler, set up for you) and
the host function — which MUST be named exactly like the step and take/return
torch tensors — is run on the GPU and compared to a PyTorch oracle.

Tensors are contiguous float32 on CUDA; index a 2-D (R,C) tensor as ptr[r*C + c].
Compiling takes ~30-60s the first time (cached after). Conventions are in each
step's docstring. Run `uv run python projects.py flash-attention-cuda` for the
full outline.

parts.title: CUDA Primitives Warm-up
parts.description: Elementwise and reduction kernels — the building blocks for matrix and attention operations.

parts.title: Matrix Operations
parts.description: The matmul, transpose, and dot-product utilities needed for attention scoring.

parts.title: Naive Attention Baseline
parts.description: Compose QK^T scoring, row-wise softmax, and PV multiplication into a straightforward attention pipeline.

parts.title: Online Softmax Math
parts.description: The running-max and running-sum updates that let softmax be computed incrementally across tiles.

parts.title: Tiled Attention Building Blocks
parts.description: Per-tile routines for loading, scoring, reducing, exponentiating, and accumulating PV.

parts.title: Fused Flash Attention Kernel
parts.description: Assemble the building blocks into the full online-softmax Flash Attention kernel and its host launcher.

parts.title: Causal Flash Attention
parts.description: Extend the kernel with a causal mask for autoregressive models.

steps.name: vector_add
steps.doc: Elementwise add two 1-D arrays: out[i] = a[i] + b[i].

steps.name: scale_array
steps.doc: Multiply every element of a 1-D array by scalar s.

steps.name: elementwise_exp
steps.doc: Apply expf elementwise: out[i] = exp(a[i]).

steps.name: row_max
steps.doc: Reduce each row of a (R,C) matrix to its max -> (R,).

steps.name: row_sum
steps.doc: Reduce each row of a (R,C) matrix to its sum -> (R,).

steps.name: dot_product
steps.doc: Dot product of two 1-D vectors -> scalar tensor.

steps.name: matmul
steps.doc: C = A @ B for A (M,K), B (K,N) -> (M,N).

steps.name: transpose
steps.doc: Transpose a (M,N) matrix -> (N,M).

steps.name: qk_scores
steps.doc: Scaled scores S = scale * Q @ K^T; Q (N,d), K (M,d) -> (N,M).

steps.name: softmax_rows
steps.doc: Numerically-stable row-wise softmax of a (R,C) matrix.

steps.name: pv_matmul
steps.doc: O = P @ V for P (N,M), V (M,d) -> (N,d).

steps.name: naive_attention
steps.doc: Full attention softmax(scale * Q@K^T) @ V -> (N,d).

steps.name: online_max
steps.doc: Elementwise running max: out[i] = max(m[i], x[i]).

steps.name: correction_factor
steps.doc: Rescale factor exp(m_old - m_new), elementwise.

steps.name: update_running_sum
steps.doc: Online denominator: out = alpha*l + s, elementwise.

steps.name: rescale_output
steps.doc: Scale each row r of O (R,d) by alpha[r].

steps.name: load_tile
steps.doc: Stage an (R,C) tile from global memory (copy it through).

steps.name: tile_scores
steps.doc: Tile-level scaled scores: scale * Q @ K^T.

steps.name: tile_rowmax
steps.doc: Row max of a score tile -> (R,).

steps.name: tile_exp
steps.doc: exp(S[r,c] - m[r]) over a score tile.

steps.name: tile_rowsum
steps.doc: Row sum of an exp'd tile -> (R,).

steps.name: accumulate_pv
steps.doc: Tile PV product P @ V -> (R,d).

steps.name: flash_attention_kernel
steps.doc: The fused online-softmax attention KERNEL (host launcher is given).

steps.name: flash_attention_launcher
steps.doc: Host launcher for the flash attention kernel (kernel is given).

steps.name: causal_mask
steps.doc: Set S[r,c] = -1e30f where c > r (mask future positions).

steps.name: flash_attention_causal_kernel
steps.doc: Causal flash attention: query r attends only to keys c <= r.
